facts: Reading anticlockwise from Q1: **A**ll positive, then only **S**ine, then only **T**angent, then only **C**osine.
In Q2, Q3 and Q4, the two ratios not named by ASTC are negative.
On the unit circle, $\sin\theta$ is the $y$-coordinate, so it is positive above the $x$-axis, in Q1 and Q2.
On the unit circle, $\cos\theta$ is the $x$-coordinate, so it is positive to the right of the $y$-axis, in Q1 and Q4.
$\tan\theta=\dfrac{\sin\theta}{\cos\theta}$ is positive where sine and cosine share a sign, in Q1 and Q3.
A given sign matches exactly two quadrants: for example $\tan\theta<0$ occurs in Q2 and Q4.
ASTC applies inside quadrants. Boundary angles lie on the axes, so check their ratio values separately: a ratio may be zero, and tangent is undefined when cosine is zero.
steps: Identify the quadrant of the angle
Use ASTC to state whether the ratio is positive or negative

workedExamples.question_text:
Use ASTC to state whether each ratio is positive or negative.
(a) $\cos 35^{\circ}$
(b) $\tan 145^{\circ}$
(c) $\sin 235^{\circ}$
(d) $\cos 305^{\circ}$

Determine the sign of each ratio.
(a) $\sin 470^{\circ}$
(b) $\cos(-65^{\circ})$
(c) $\tan(-865^{\circ})$
(d) $\cos 1195^{\circ}$
workedExamples.solution_text:
(a) Subtract $360^{\circ}$.
$470^{\circ}-360^{\circ}=110^{\circ}$.
$110^{\circ}$ is in Q2, where only sine is positive. $\sin 470^{\circ}$ is positive.

(b) Add $360^{\circ}$.
$-65^{\circ}+360^{\circ}=295^{\circ}$.
$295^{\circ}$ is in Q4, where only cosine is positive. $\cos(-65^{\circ})$ is positive.

(c) Add $360^{\circ}$ repeatedly.
$\begin{aligned}-865^{\circ}+360^{\circ}&=-505^{\circ}\\-505^{\circ}+360^{\circ}&=-145^{\circ}\\-145^{\circ}+360^{\circ}&=215^{\circ}\end{aligned}$
$215^{\circ}$ is in Q3, where only tangent is positive. $\tan(-865^{\circ})$ is positive.

(d) Subtract $360^{\circ}$ repeatedly.
$\begin{aligned}1195^{\circ}-360^{\circ}&=835^{\circ}\\835^{\circ}-360^{\circ}&=475^{\circ}\\475^{\circ}-360^{\circ}&=115^{\circ}\end{aligned}$
$115^{\circ}$ is in Q2, where only sine is positive. $\cos 1195^{\circ}$ is negative.

workedExamples.question_text:
State the two quadrants in which each condition holds.
(a) $\sin\theta<0$
(b) $\cos\theta<0$
(c) $\tan\theta>0$
workedExamples.solution_text:
(a) Sine is positive in Q1 and Q2, so $\sin\theta<0$ in Q3 and Q4.

(b) Cosine is positive in Q1 and Q4, so $\cos\theta<0$ in Q2 and Q3.

(c) All ratios are positive in Q1, and tangent is positive in Q3. Therefore $\tan\theta>0$ in Q1 and Q3.

workedExamples.question_text:
Which of sine, cosine and tangent is positive for each angle?
(a) $\theta=115^{\circ}$
(b) $\theta=245^{\circ}$
(c) $\theta=325^{\circ}$
workedExamples.solution_text:
(a) $115^{\circ}$ is in Q2. ASTC gives sine as the only positive ratio, so $\sin\theta$ is positive.

(b) $245^{\circ}$ is in Q3. ASTC gives tangent as the only positive ratio, so $\tan\theta$ is positive.

(c) $325^{\circ}$ is in Q4. ASTC gives cosine as the only positive ratio, so $\cos\theta$ is positive.
